notes.title: V.1.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
V.1.3.0 Is Finally Here!

Changelog:

>Added Item Store (Now store is divided in two sections)
>Added Item Box
>Added Time Freezer Item (Can be obtained only through store)
>Added Fire Alarm
>Added 60 New Language Sentences
>Fixed Many Bugs
>Added Computer Science Achievement
>Added Fire Alarm Achievement
>Removed Free Mode (Now accessible through Level Store)
>You can now Skip DyymaStudio Intro Cutscene
>Sanity now decreases while you are in a notebook instead of running

LEVELS:
>Added Computer Science Level
>Added placeholder preview for the Next Bonus Level (National Flags)
